description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Last Stand] and [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1], grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Reks], [Patriot's Sword Damage Tracker] and [Patriot's Sword Level]

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Reks
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Patriot's Sword (0~2), removed after using Patriot's Sword two times

description.name: Patriot's Sword Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Patriot's Sword level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Reks]

description.name: Patriot's Sword Level
description.text: Keeps track of Patriot's Sword level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Reks]
